answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond proportional to its voting weight before it can act. To spin up a sybil swarm of a thousand fake peers, name them meadow, yarrow, falcon and so on, the attacker must fund a thousand separate bonds up front. Any identity caught double-signing is slashed and forfeits its deposit, while honest agents recover theirs. So the cost of forging identities grows linearly with their count, but the influence each buys does not.
